paragraphs.source_en: This threw Saji Hyūga-no-kami into utter confusion. In truth, Hideyoshi had never intended to marry Tatsu to Yogorō Kazunari. paragraphs.source_en: Hyūga-no-kami did not understand why Hideyoshi had spoken so. At the time he dismissed it as a trifling matter, but later he gradually came to grasp the meaning.
